properties.name: Geta PFMP provisional research envelope
properties.geometry_role: Coarse envelope for source coverage research and engineering dry-runs only
properties.reference_area_meaning: Area stated for Geta Forest Station in the PFMP; not the area of this rectangle
properties.source_section: 2.1 Geographic Location, printed page 20; Figure 1, printed page 21
properties.coordinate_interpretation: The PFMP uses quote-like marks after the second coordinate number; these were interpreted as degrees-and-minutes notation, not seconds, and converted to decimal degrees. Its geographic datum is unspecified; WGS84 is assumed for this provisional RFC 7946 GeoJSON representation.
properties.limitations: The rectangle encloses the PFMP's stated location range and includes surrounding land. It is not a surveyed or digitized forest boundary, does not establish ownership or legal scope, and must not be used to claim forest area or characterize a pixel as inside Geta Forest.
